source_notes: Figure 3B prose/caption shell-composition conflict is unresolved; no specific route gets its panel-B TEM size.
Figure 2 belongs only to the 3.3 nm CdSe core and CdS/ZnS/CdS/ZnS route. Figure 5 has four panel-specific routes. Figure 6 is an explanatory two-route diagram.
Initial and final optical FWHM values in Figure 2d and Table 1 are retained as separate reported contexts.
Source figure permissions unverified despite owner-selected public display.
evidence_conflicts: Figure 3B shell composition differs between prose and caption; no route-specific size assignment.
Figure 2d and Table 1 initial/final PL FWHM values differ by reporting context.
remaining_gaps: No source-measured atomic coordinates for any exact nanocrystal or interface.
Most shell products lack source-assigned TEM morphology; diagrammatic shells are not measurements.
training_note: Bulk reference cells and conceptual shell diagrams are not verified sample-coordinate training labels.
